title: QC Technician
description: Good quality decisions start with accurate checks, clear records and the confidence to act when something is not right. We are looking for a QC Technician to help ensure our products are manufactured to the required specifications. This is a hands\-on role supporting production through water batching and testing, in\-process checks, quality inspections and the effective management of non\-conforming materials. As a QC Technician, you will work closely with Production and Engineering to help maintain product quality throughout the manufacturing process. Your responsibilities will range from batching and testing water to completing start\-up checks, inspecting products and making decisions based on your findings. When a product or material does not meet the required standard, you will take ownership of identifying, isolating and recording the issue while supporting the investigation and follow\-up. This is a varied role where your judgement matters. Your work will help protect product quality, maintain traceability and keep production moving safely and effectively. You will also contribute to continuous improvement through GMP audits, complaint monitoring, employee training, new product development trials and pilot runs. **What You’ll Be Accountable For** * Batching water to meet production requirements and completing the necessary analytical and chemical quality testing. * Making appropriate decisions on water usage based on testing results. * Taking samples for microbiological analysis using aseptic techniques. * Completing equipment calibration, start\-up checks, metal\-detector checks and routine quality control testing. * Performing in\-process inspections and checks to confirm that products meet the required specifications. * Making timely product\-quality decisions based on inspection and testing results. * Identifying, isolating and recording non\-conforming products or materials. * Quarantining defective or potentially defective finished products and raw materials. * Maintaining complete traceability for quarantined and reworked products. * Supporting root\-cause investigations and the completion of corrective and preventive actions. * Communicating quality concerns clearly to Production, Engineering, suppliers and relevant internal teams. * Monitoring GMP compliance and completing routine GMP, glass and Perspex audits. * Maintaining accurate and timely quality records. * Supporting external audits and accreditation activities. * Training colleagues to complete production and quality checks in line with approved procedures. * Maintaining stock levels and keeping work areas organised using 6S principles. * Supporting quality activities across IB1, IB2, the cleanroom, packing area and water room. * Playing an active part in new product development trials and pilot production runs. * Following company procedures, SOPs and safe systems of work while contributing to improvements where needed. **Who This Role Is For** This role will suit someone who is practical, observant and comfortable making decisions based on facts. Previous experience in quality control, manufacturing or FMCG would be valuable. Internal quality training or experience will also be considered, so we encourage applications from people who have developed relevant quality knowledge within a production environment. **You Should Bring** * An understanding of GMP and why it matters in a manufacturing environment. * The ability to follow SOPs and established quality procedures consistently. * Confidence undertaking practical checks, inspections and testing. * Good computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint. * Clear written and verbal communication. * The flexibility to work a rotating 12\-hour shift pattern over a three\-week cycle. Around two years’ experience in a quality function would be desirable, but it is not essential where you can demonstrate the right practical experience, judgement and ability to learn. **What Will Make You Successful Here** You pay attention to the details because you understand that small variations can affect product quality. You are comfortable making decisions within agreed procedures. When something falls outside those procedures, you raise it quickly and clearly rather than making assumptions. You can organise several priorities, maintain accurate records and complete checks on time without compromising quality or safety. You communicate well with people across Production, Engineering and Quality. You can explain an issue clearly, listen to operational input and work with others to reach the right outcome. You are also willing to learn new practical techniques, share your knowledge and help colleagues follow quality procedures correctly. Most importantly, you take ownership. You do not simply identify a problem. You help ensure it is isolated, recorded, communicated and followed through. **Why Join WaterWipes** At WaterWipes, product quality is central to the trust consumers place in our products. This role puts you close to the manufacturing process, where your checks and decisions can have an immediate and visible impact. You will gain exposure to water quality, microbiological sampling, production inspections, investigations, audits and new product trials. You will work across functions and different production areas, giving you the opportunity to develop a broad understanding of quality within a fast\-moving FMCG environment. It is a strong opportunity for someone who wants to build practical quality experience and contribute to continuous improvement while remaining close to day\-to\-day production. **Location \& Practicalities** This is a **site\-based position in Drogheda, Co. Louth** . The role operates on a **rotating 12\-hour shift pattern over a three\-week cycle** . Candidates should consider whether this working arrangement suits their personal circumstances before applying. The position provides quality coverage across different production areas, including IB1, IB2, the cleanroom, packing area and water room. The specific shift times and full working pattern will be explained during the recruitment process. If you have practical manufacturing or quality experience, good attention to detail and the confidence to make evidence\-based decisions, we would like to hear from you. Apply with your CV and tell us about the quality checks, production processes or manufacturing standards you have worked with. WaterWipes® was created by our founder Edward McCloskey after his newborn daughter developed a nappy rash on her sensitive skin. After an extensive search he couldn’t find a baby wipe that didn’t contain numerous ingredients, so he decided to make his own. Many years later and after a lot of hard work, testing, and scientific research, WaterWipes® was born. Pure and gentle for the most delicate skin but in the convenience of a baby wipe, WaterWipes® are purer than cotton wool and water. Every day, parents around the world are discovering the benefits of our gentle and effective WaterWipes® for their baby’s skin. We hope you like them too.

title: Registrar in Orthopaedic Surgery - January 2027
description: Overview: **BEAUMONT HOSPITAL****(Incorporating St Joseph’s Hospital, Raheny)** Beaumont Hospital, incorporating St. Joseph’s Hospital Raheny, is a large academic teaching hospital 5km north of Dublin City centre. Beaumont Hospital provides emergency and acute care services across 54 medical specialties to a local community of some 290,000 people. In addition, Beaumont Hospital is a designated cancer centre and the regional treatment centre for ear, nose and throat, and gastroenterology, and the national referral centre for neurosurgery and neurology, renal transplantation, cochlear implantation and mechanical thrombectomy. Beaumont Hospital is the lead Level 4 hospital within the Royal College of Surgeons Hospital Group, which includes Connolly Hospital, Rotunda Hospital, Cavan/Monaghan Hospitals, Louth/Meath Hospitals, and the Royal College of Surgeons. A dedicated Care of the Elderly Rehabilitation Unit and a 100 bedded Raheny Community Nursing Unit have also been developed on the St. Joseph’s campus. **Applications are invited from suitably qualified doctors for the following posts which are available from 11th January 2027\.** **Registrar** **in Orthopaedic Surgery** Post Specifications:* Each candidate **must** hold a valid **Irish Medical Council Registration** * English Language Competency: All doctors taking up employment who were not registered with the Irish Medical Council in any of the divisions of the Register of Medical Practitioners prior to **1****st** **January 2015**, or who did not complete the entirety of their under\-graduate medical training in the Republic of Ireland, are required to provide evidence of one of the following: * + Completion of your Medical degree in English from any of the following countries: Australia, Canada, New Zealand, The United States of America or The United Kingdom. title: S&I Graduate
description: ***Your recipe for a rewarding career starts here!*** **About Us** Established in 1985, Dawn Farms is a **family\-owned company** and the largest dedicated supplier of **cooked meat and plant\-based ingredients and fermented and dried sausage products** outside of the US. The company currently supplies world\-leading food brands across more than 44 markets, including the UK, Europe, Asia and Africa. With over 1,000 employees we are committed to meeting the needs of our customers in a safe, innovative and sustainable way, all while strengthening the communities where they live and work. **Job Purpose** Dawn Farms is currently seeking an **S\&I Graduate** to join our **Science \& Innovation Department** to be based in our state of the art production facilities in **Naas, Co. Kildare** . The Science \& Innovation (S\&I) Graduate will play a key role in planning and testing new ideas, contributing to the growth of the business across different innovation platforms and markets. This position offers exposure to state\-of\-the\-art food research and manufacturing, as well as diverse protein product development and applications. Candidates will work in a team environment and are expected to have a passion for science and technology, with knowledge in Chemistry, Nutrition, Process Engineering, and Food Science. This multidisciplinary role involves learning new techniques, conducting practical experiments/trials, and handling multiple assignments within the S\&I team. **Positions:** Full\-Time, Fixed Term 2 years. **Location:** Naas, Co. Kildare, Ireland. **Salary:** DOE **Working Hours:** 39 hours per week, Mon. \- Fri. (some flexibility required) **Role Responsibilities \& Duties:** * Plan and execute practical experiments and trials, designing and testing new or improved methods and products in the S\&I Pure Culinary Science kitchen, pilot plant, or factories, * Collaborate closely with experienced Project Managers, advising on trial design, timelines, potential hurdles, and improvements to achieve technical advances. * Generate and interpret data, maintain SharePoint databases, and document results in OneNote and other Microsoft suite applications. * Present data and results effectively to the S\&I team to drive decisions during the experimental and prototype testing phase. * Evaluate new ingredients, materials, products, or processes to build S\&I capabilities. * Develop expertise in process and analytical methodologies, preparing and updating specifications and SOPs. * Capture key learnings and feedback to share within internal communications, improving our innovation process. * Coordinate trial planning and knowledge transfer within the team. * Work with cross\-functional departments to execute collaborative project tasks. * Provide scientific and technical guidance to other team members and departments as needed. * Ensure food safety and adhere to health and safety policies, standard operating procedures, and good hygiene practices. **Key Deliverables:** * Execution of practical trials, ensuring they are completed in a timely manner and based on the given brief. * Update trial reports and communication platforms daily. * Generation of high\-quality reports and documentation, stored on SharePoint and OneNote. * Completion and review of trial reports and products with Project Managers. * Push projects to the next stage. * Achieve technical advances during trials. **Key Skills \& Competencies:** * Degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Chemistry, Food Fermentation, or related field. * General understanding of food applications and processing. * Excellent record\-keeping and organizational skills with strong attention to detail. * Ability to read, collect, analyse, and interpret technical information and data. * Logical and scientific thinking applied to a wide range of problems. * Ability to operate standard laboratory and pilot equipment following training. * Troubleshooting skills are key to this role, and the candidate should be highly motivated and eager to learn. * Project management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple activities simultaneously. * Ability to distinguish colours and flavours. * Understanding of GMP and Food Safety concepts. * Good verbal and written communication skills. * Proficiency in mathematical concepts such as percent, ppm, and basic algebraic equations. * Ability to build constructive relationships with internal and external stakeholders. * Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office programs. * Willingness to travel as required. * Regularly required to lift and/or move materials or equipment up to 10kg and occasionally up to 20kg. **Why Dawn Farms?** We can offer an excellent opportunity to be part of a world\-class team, equipping our teams with the knowledge and the necessary skills to achieve their full potential. Innovation is a key ingredient of our success in protecting our market position and keeping our competitive edge. To be truly innovative, we invest in recruiting and developing a highly skilled, ambitious and talented team. **What we can offer you?** * 22 Days Annual Leave. * Health Insurance Contribution. * Pension Plan. * Subsided Canteen. * Training and Development Opportunities for further career progression. * Employee Assistance Programme (Free access/support to Life Coach’s, Dietitians, Work Relocation advice etc.) * Bike to Work Scheme. * Christmas savings scheme. *'Dawn Farm Foods Ltd. is an equal opprtunities employer'*

description: **Mason Hayes Curran Summer Internship 2027** Applications open: Tuesday 8 September 2026 Applications close: Wednesday 21 October 2026 at 5:00PM **Why choose MHC for graduate opportunities?** We are focused on finding exceptional trainees who will ultimately become the future lawyers and leaders of our firm. title: Support Worker - Female Only
description: Additional Information: **Location**: Misneach Supported Living Service, Trim, Co Meath **GOR:** Due to a genuine occupational requirement (GOR) this role is only open to female applicants. **Hours**: Full time, Part Time hours and relief hours are available with this role. Full\-time hours are based on 37\.5 hours FTE. Part\-time roles will be subject to pro rata. Salary for Relief role is €15\.03 up to €22\.19 per hour. **Support work is an impactful job. It's the reason people get to live life their way.** Join Positive Futures as a Support Worker and help people with a learning disability, acquired brain injury or autism to live independently, and to have real choice and control over their own lives. You don't need formal qualifications or experience for this role, just kindness, patience, and a sense of fun. You'll get to know the person you're supporting properly: their goals, their routines, what independence looks like for them. From there, you'll support them with everything from daily living skills and personal care, to getting out into their community, keeping in touch with the people who matter to them, and speaking up for themselves. * **A proper start:** Receive a full, paid induction before you're expected to hit the ground running, and join a dedicated team who'll support you every step of the way. * **Genuine independence, genuine impact:** Help people manage their homes, their finances, their health and their social lives, all in a way that puts their choices first. * **No experience required, just the right qualities:** If you're kind, patient, and reliable, we'll teach you the rest, and we'll cover your NISCC registration too. If you're looking for work that means something, makes a real difference to people, every day, and you've got the patience and values this role needs, we'd love to hear from you. **About The Role** **Every day looks a little different, because every person you support is different too.** As a Support Worker, you'll form a positive relationship with the person you support, always maintaining appropriate professional boundaries with them and their families. You'll help them look after their home, manage their money and medication as independently as possible, and get the right support from other services when they need it, whether that's a GP, a social worker, or an advocate. You'll support people to stay safe and healthy in every part of their life, including personal care where it's needed, always treating people with dignity and respect. You'll help them get out into their community, stay connected to the people who matter to them, and speak up for themselves, seeking advocacy support where it's needed rather than deciding things for them. You'll also act as a role model for other staff and volunteers, sharing what you learn and helping new colleagues find their feet. Accurate record keeping (incidents, risk assessments, communication logs) is part of the job too, using our usual digital systems. If you can bring warmth, reliability and genuine respect for people's right to choose their own life, this is a role where that really counts. **Required Criteria** * Minimum 6 months experience providing paid or voluntary care or support for someone. * Full, valid IRL/UK/EU/EEA driving licence or an ability to travel independently to meet the requirements of the post. **Desired Criteria** * Previous experience of supporting someone with autism * Recognised Level 5 award relevant to the role * Relevant third level qualification at degree level i.e. social work, psychology, and/or allied health. * Proficiency in using standard office IT applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook. * Post\-graduate qualification relevant to the role **Skills Needed** **Salary** €30,569\.00 \- €45,117\.00 per year
